newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Usko leaps after Metkor divests.
newsitem.headline: Usko leaps after Metkor divests.

text.p: Shares in South African electrical conductor firm, Usko Ltd leapt over 33 percent in early Wednesday dealings on news that the Metkor Group Ltd had sold its 27.3 percent stake in the firm.
The shares touched a high of 56 cents before settling back to 52 cents, up 11 cents on the day, by 0855 GMT.

Dealers said investors were cheering the quality of the buyer's of Metkor's stake who included funds under the management of Capital Partners Ltd, Fedsure Asset Management, Genbel Securities Ltd and John Beck.

"That's very positive for the market because, Genbel specifically is perceived to be quite a quality trading outfit and if it's good enough for them then its obviously good enough for every managed fund that's buying today," said one dealer.
Stock traders said Ukso shares were likely to stabilise around 50 cents once the morning's flurry of interest had abated.
Usko had gained ground in heavy dealings in recent days on speculation of a takeover.
Metkor's holding was sold by parent Rembrandt Group Ltd for 38 cents a share cash, with effect from May 30.
